sources.title: Acehnese parents’ attitudes and their implications in the intergenerational transmission of the heritage language
sources.publisher: Universitas Syiah Kuala / Studies in English Language and Education
sources.locator: Qualitative study of 20 Acehnese-speaking female parents in two suburbs of Lhokseumawe; findings concern parental attitudes, home-domain language practice and intergenerational transmission.

sources.title: The Acehnese Language Use in South Aceh Regency: A Sociolinguistic Analysis
sources.publisher: UIN Syarif Hidayatullah Jakarta / Buletin Al-Turas
sources.locator: Qualitative sociolinguistic study of Acehnese-language use in South Aceh Regency using documentary work, field studies, focus groups and interviews.

whoTheyAre.summary: The live source identifies Acehnese in Indonesia and ties the record to Aceh (ace). Glottolog independently identifies Acehnese, while recent locality-specific sociolinguistic studies document both active heritage-language maintenance efforts and pressures affecting intergenerational use.

religionAndCommunity.summary: PeopleGroups.org supplies an aggregate 'Islam - Sunni' label for this record. It is retained as source context and is not generalized into a statement about every Acehnese person's belief or practice.

profile.whyUnreachedIntro: The current mission classification is explained only from PeopleGroups.org mission fields. Acehnese language maintenance, regional culture and Sunni identity are not treated as causes of unreached status.

claims.text: The live PeopleGroups.org record PG022477 reports PEID 22477, display name Acehnese, country Indonesia and primary language Aceh (ace).
Glottolog identifies Acehnese with glottocode achi1257 and ISO 639-3 code ace and lists Indonesia as its country.
claims.interpretationNote: Glottolog's vitality/status metadata is language-level context and does not describe the language practice of every Acehnese household.

claims.text: Recent studies in Lhokseumawe and South Aceh document locality- and household-specific variation in Acehnese language use and intergenerational transmission, including both maintenance efforts and pressures toward language shift.
claims.interpretationNote: These studies cover specific localities and samples. Their findings are not generalized into one current language-use pattern for all Acehnese communities.

claims.text: The live PeopleGroups.org record reports 'Islam - Sunni' as the aggregate primary-religion label for PG022477.
claims.interpretationNote: This is a provider classification for one people-group-in-country record, not a statement about every Acehnese person's belief or practice.

claims.text: The live PeopleGroups.org record reports GSEC 1, less than 2% evangelical presence and no recent church-planting activity for PG022477; it separately reports Engaged status and existing congregations.
claims.interpretationNote: These source-native mission fields coexist in the live record and are not reconciled into an invented verdict.

claims.text: The live structured record reports Bible availability as Available, Jesus Film availability as Available and four total evangelical resources for PG022477.
claims.interpretationNote: Structured provider availability fields do not establish distribution, comprehension, use or translation completeness; public partner-resource surfaces may not display an identical combination.
